headline: ACCT reports cross-model context-state transfer across three model families
summary: A preprint introduces ACCT, which converts KV states already computed by one model into sparse KV states that a different-size model in the same family can use without re-encoding the full context. Across six directed pairs in Qwen3, Llama and Qwen2.5, authors report 4x KV-slot compression and mixed task results. The 6.5–21.2x speed headline measures conversion against target prefill and excludes source-model prefill. Appendix K includes source prefill: at the longest tested context, only three smaller-to-larger directions are faster than target-only prefill, while reverse directions are slower. These are author-reported experiments, not independent production evidence.
